pairs.difference: Swiggy is orange and also has Instamart; Zomato is red, started with restaurant reviews and has Blinkit.
Ola is the Indian company, green-and-black, with e-scooters too; Uber is the global, black-and-white one.
Amazon is American, with Prime and Alexa; Flipkart is Indian, with the Big Billion Days sale.
Coke is red, owned by Coca-Cola, and the Thums Up family; Pepsi is blue, with the "Yeh Dil Maange More" ads.
Decathlon is a giant sports store with cycles and tents; IKEA is a giant Swedish furniture store with flat-pack and meatballs.
Paytm started as a wallet and is blue; PhonePe is purple and UPI-first.
Netflix is red and has Money Heist; Prime Video comes with Amazon Prime and has Mirzapur.
Parle-G is a sweet glucose biscuit with a baby on the pack; Marie Gold is Britannia's round, light tea biscuit.
Nike has the swoosh and "Just Do It"; Adidas has the three stripes.
Bournvita is chocolatey and purple; Horlicks is malty and white-and-blue.
Fevicol is white glue for wood and paper; Fevikwik is an instant drop that sticks fingers together.
Starbucks is the American chain, green, with your name on the cup; CCD is Café Coffee Day, the Indian chain ("A lot can happen over coffee").
McDonald's has golden arches, burgers and the McAloo Tikki; KFC has fried chicken buckets and the Colonel.
Domino's delivers pizza in 30 minutes; at Subway you build a sub at the counter.
Dairy Milk is a solid Cadbury bar ("Kuch meetha ho jaaye"); KitKat is Nestlé wafer fingers ("Have a break").
WhatsApp is chats and family groups; Instagram is reels, stories and posts.
Apple makes iPhones and Macs; Samsung makes Galaxy phones and TVs.
Myntra is for clothes and fashion; Nykaa is for beauty and make-up.
Lay's are thin potato chips; Kurkure are crunchy, twisted masala sticks.
IndiGo is a blue, low-cost airline; Air India has the Maharaja and international routes.
IRCTC is the railway booking site (Tatkal); MakeMyTrip books flights and hotels.
Facebook is for family, friends and old photos; LinkedIn is for jobs and work posts.
Google is where you search; Wikipedia is the encyclopedia you end up reading.
Lego is building bricks; Hot Wheels is toy cars on orange tracks.
Red Bull is an energy drink ("gives you wings"); Bisleri is bottled water.
Thums Up is a strong cola; Frooti is a mango drink in a tetra pack.
Maruti makes everyday cars; Royal Enfield makes the Bullet motorbike.
Candy Crush is a match-three puzzle; Temple Run is an endless running game.
Spotify is a music app on your phone; Alexa is Amazon's voice assistant in a smart speaker.
Colgate is toothpaste; Dettol is the antiseptic liquid and soap.
